segments.name: Retirement
segments.description: Provides retirement plan solutions, administration technology and services to U.S. employers, plus individual retirement accounts and advisory services through Wealth Management.
segments.evidence: Our Retirement segment provides retirement plan solutions and administration technology and services to employers through our Retirement business.

segments.name: Investment Management
segments.description: A leading international asset manager serving institutions, financial intermediaries and individual investors globally.
segments.evidence: A leading international asset manager with global distribution capabilities, managing public and private fixed income, equities, multi-asset solutions and alternative strategies for institutions, financial intermediaries and individual investors.

segments.name: Employee Benefits
segments.description: Provides supplemental health and other group benefits and, through Benefitfocus, benefits administration solutions to employers and health plans.
segments.evidence: A leading provider of supplemental health and other group benefits covering approximately 6.8 million individual lives in the U.S. providing a comprehensive portfolio of stop loss, life, disability and voluntary insurance products, along with health savings and spending accounts.

revenueModel.text: Voya earns fee income from asset-based and participant-based administrative, recordkeeping and advisory fees, investment income from general account assets, insurance premiums, and market-based fees for managing assets.
revenueModel.evidence: Fee income is generated from asset based and participant based administrative, recordkeeping and advisory fees.

changes.text: In 2025, Voya completed the acquisition of the full-service retirement plan business of OneAmerica Financial.
changes.evidence: On January 2, 2025, we completed the acquisition of the full-service retirement plan business of OneAmerica Financial through the purchase of legal entities and an indemnity reinsurance agreement.
